description: This Java class provides utility methods for theming and styling the Notes app's views, including coloring navigation items, theming toolbars, and customizing UI components based on themes and color schemes.

classes.name: NotesViewThemeUtils
classes.description: Utility class for applying theme and styling customizations to views within the Notes Android application, utilizing dynamic colors and schemes.

methods.name: colorNavigationViewItem
methods.description: Colors a navigation view item according to the current color scheme, highlighting selected states.

methods.name: colorNavigationViewItemIcon
methods.description: Colors a navigation view item's icon based on selection state and color scheme.

methods.name: colorNavigationViewItemText
methods.description: Colors a navigation view item's text based on selection state and color scheme.

methods.name: applyBrandToPrimaryToolbar
methods.description: Deprecated; applies a primary color scheme to the toolbar and overflow/navigation icons.

methods.name: colorLayerDrawable
methods.description: Colors a specific layer within a LayerDrawable.

methods.name: getTextHighlightBackgroundColor
methods.description: Determines the appropriate background color for text highlights based on main color and theme (dark/light).

methods.name: themeSearchCardView
methods.description: Deprecated; themes a MaterialCardView for search purposes based on dynamic color schemes.

methods.name: themeSearchToolbar
methods.description: Deprecated; themes a MaterialToolbar for search purposes based on dynamic color schemes.

methods.name: themeToolbarSearchView
methods.description: Deprecated; themes a SearchView component for consistent appearance with the app theme.

methods.name: themeInternalLinkIcon
methods.description: Applies theme-based color filters to an ImageView representing an internal link icon.

methods.name: themeBackgroundItemView
methods.description: Themes the background of a view, applying different states based on activation.

methods.name: themeCard
methods.description: Themes a MaterialCardView with a background and stroke color based on material schemes.
